caption:
Me going out for just milk

Me going out for just milk.

A list on your phone beats a list in your head. Without one, the store decides what you need.

Send it to the friend who comes back with everything except the milk.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. An entryway. A small ink-black block figure with white eyes walks toward the door, looks, and comes back. One by one a bread roll, a tangerine, a candy and a small bite pop onto the floor beside it, each with a small pulse. In the last second the text changes from: me going out for just milk, to: I forgot the milk, and the figure's eyes go wide and it trembles. It narrows its eyes at the camera.
